title: Updates by itself, Movies, Pahadi songs, real moods and a smarter AI DJ

items.text: 🔄 Updates by itself: when there's internet, a new version downloads and installs on its own while you're not using the app. Turn it off in Settings → App update.
🤖 The AI DJ also asks a free online AI (GLM, DeepSeek) for songs. Only songs that really exist are played (Settings → Free online AI).
🎬 Movies: every Indian film with its release year, music director, producers, director and cast. Filter by language and decade, or search any name ("Pritam", "Yash Raj Films", "Shah Rukh Khan").
Search a movie's name to get its album: all its songs, playing one after another.
Moods (Happy, Sad, Party…), Home rows and festivals now come from playlists made for them, not from songs that only have the word in their name or singer.
🏔️ Pahadi: Garhwali, Kumaoni, Jaunsari and Himachali songs in a new category.

🤖 AI DJ talks like a person now: say "sad Punjabi songs", then "no remix", "only Arijit", "more" or "make it happy" and it changes the mix. It also gets "Kesariya jaise gaane" and a film's name ("Aashiqui 2 ke gaane").
With your own Anthropic API key (Settings), the AI DJ uses Claude Haiku 5.5: fast and low-cost.

🤝 Help improve suggestions: now and then, when there's internet, the app shares what you search, like, play and keep in playlists, with no name, number or phone files, so For You, radio and the AI DJ learn from all Sangeet listeners. Turn it off in Settings.
🤝 For You and radio also learn from what other Sangeet listeners play.
Pahadi is now a song language in Settings → Song languages.
YouTube songs play more reliably (updated YouTube player).
YouTube and YouTube Music playlists import again, up to 2000 songs.
After a song you searched, similar songs in that song's language follow.
Report a problem sends your report again.
What's new: this list, after every update and in Settings.
🎁 Wrapped: your year in music as a card to share (Library → Your Stats).
🤝 Blend with a friend: one playlist from both your tastes.
Share a line from the lyrics as a picture (long-press a lyrics line).
🚗 Car mode: big buttons in Now Playing.
🆕 New from your singers on Home.
More songs: the song list now grows three times a day (over 12 lakh songs).
YouTube in background (experimental, Settings).
Download songs to play without internet, and Save to Files.
Liquid Glass look (Settings → Look).
🎤 Voice search, and search by a line from the lyrics.
Recent searches in the search bar.
Liquid Glass theme, now also in light mode; the time and battery at the top follow the theme.
Tap a tab to go back to its start; song languages are in Settings and on Home.
A song you pick from search is followed by songs like it.
😎 Haryanvi Badmashi category.
Search by singer's name; lock screen and Dynamic Island controls.
